items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I had been introduced to him by Gladys Mosier who is a pianist in Pittsburg... Gladys Mosier's band was playing at the Paramount Theatre. We located her... I met Gladys Mosier in Pittsburgh

ctx.x: Yes. And I had been introduced to him by Gladys Mosier who is a pianist in Pittsburg.
So he set up this record date, and I recorded. And he had a male singer -- he's probably listed -- is it listed as "Dark As Ever"? What is it? "Harbor Lights." I don't know who the vocal --
